text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her debut race imminent, Mejiro Ardan pushes herself until the last possible moment. The fire in her eyes can only be described as a raging inferno.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of Mejiro Ardan's debut. The race begins and, concentrating intensely, she hits the ground running.
